# tenure rights

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureRights`](gmeow-tenureRights.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureRights>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The machine-readable rights statement (permissions, prohibitions, duties) that governs this land tenure. Links to the rights facility by reference. Non-functional: multiple legal instruments may apply to the same tenure (e.g. national law + local ordinance + indigenous treaty).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md)
